cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: Rozšířit základní vědomosti o přírodě, kterou studenti na MENDELU poznávají, o nejsložitější složku, o člověka, s důrazem na komunikaci, kterou budou absolventi potřebovat nejen v zaměstnání. Úkolem je podrobně seznámit studenty s efektivní analýzou jakékoliv sociální situace, aby mohlo být stanoveno její účelné komunikační řešení (asertivita, manipulace, diskuse, konsensus). Rétorika, disputace, marketing. Hodnocení obsahu sdělení, výběru užitých slov, způsob sdělení - zvuky a řeč těla. při nacvičování jednotlivých typů komunikace, zejména prezentace tezí závěrečných prací.

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: There is an aim to reach broaden knowledge about nature, which students on MENDELU learning about, concerning the most comlicated part, about man, forcefully by communication, usefull not only in occupation, but also in personal life. Student will aquitain with effective analyse of any social situation which shloudl have communitative solution.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Sociální komunikace a rétorika. (allowance 0/0) a.Communication I Origin and development interactive conveyance and effect on human activity. Five levels of communication; ethology -- research of behaviour as product of culture.b.Communication II Complex desription of comonent parts in Jacobson's model; impact of emotions, context of surroundigs; professional metacommunication; media and indirect symbols.c.Language I Word: object, notion, pattern; connotation and denotation; selective perception, barriers of contact.d.Language II Different types of word and theirs stylling incidence; scholalrly terms: facts, pieces of knowledge, verity, statement.e.Rhetorics: origin and development, main personators; forms and means odf social utterance; rhetorical genre, garniture, figures and trops.f.Nonverbal communication as comprehensible signal of emotions and situational appreciation; proxemics, posturing, motioning, gestures, mimicry, eyeviews, tatches, odours.g.Breathing by speech; other matters of communication; artistry to convince.h.Training in communication situation -- introduction.i.Training in communication situation -- work order.j.Training in communication situation -- job interview.k.Training in communication situation -- sacking.l.Training in communication situation -- employee appraisal.m.Training in communication situation -- presentaion of individual theme.n.Training in communication situation -- presentation of bachelor thesis (final report).

en.label: [section] Assessment methods:
en.content: Credit for minimmally 80% of course attendence and participation on the oral presentation of communication situations. If the requirements are not fulfilled, there is possibility to writte seminar paper (essay on 3 lists) on selected theme. On the end there will be oral interview (colloquium) of knowledge from lectures and training.
